visualCharacteristics.purpose: video cards that open a video player in a modal
visualCharacteristics.description: Three video cards: bordered thumbnail + title + Watch Video link (opens video modal)

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1 = video thumbnail image, cell 2 = title paragraph + Watch Video link (YouTube or Vimeo URL)
contentPattern.notes: Thumbnail and link both open the video in the shared modal; non-video links behave normally.
